components.name: Navigation link
components.description: Compact, accessible navigation link with current-page and hover states.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; color: #2e353f; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none; font: 400 13px/1.5 Work Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { background: #2835970a; color: #283597; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #283597; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-project-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #2e353f; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d1dce5; border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-project-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #283597; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-project-image { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: #eef6ff; color: #283597; font: 700 1.2rem/1.25 "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-project-body { padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-project-body h3 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; color: #1a202c; font: 600 1.44rem/1.25 "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-project-body time, .ds-project-body p { color: #4f5969; font: 400 0.833rem/1.5 Work Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.5em; color: #283597; background: rgba(40, 53, 151, 0.08); border-radius: 3px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.5 Work Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
This is a practical, clear visual system: a pale graph-paper ground, restrained deep-blue signals, and structured content that makes education and technology work easy to scan. Space Grotesk gives headings a distinct geometric voice; Work Sans keeps longer reading comfortable. The mood is capable and approachable without relying on decorative effects to create personality.

The design stays mostly flat. Fine borders, spacing, typography, and small state changes provide structure, while occasional soft shadows distinguish an open navigation panel or an interactive card. The same foundation supports the portfolio and its project-focused pages; the separate School Data Solutions identity remains its own brand rather than a visual synonym.
keyCharacteristics: Pale graph-paper canvas and a consistent 24px rhythm.
Deep blue used as a focused navigation and emphasis color.
Geometric display headings paired with readable sans-serif body copy.
Border-led components with restrained, state-driven depth.
dos: Do use the graph-paper surface as a subtle backdrop, not as a substitute for clear content hierarchy.
Do reserve Notebook Blue for navigation, focus, and meaningful emphasis.
Do keep most surfaces flat and use borders to establish structure.
Do retain the Space Grotesk and Work Sans role pairing and the 24px spacing rhythm.
donts: Don't spread shadows across every component; the incumbent uses them selectively for interactive depth.
Don't treat the distinct School Data Solutions identity as interchangeable with the portfolio brand.
